name: SPGuestPeoplePicker
label: Show guest users in the SharePoint People Picker
helpText: Controls whether existing guest users appear as suggestions in the SharePoint and OneDrive People Picker. Applies to the tenant default and all existing sites, since changing the tenant setting alone does not update existing sites.
executiveText: Makes existing external collaborators discoverable (or hidden) when sharing SharePoint and OneDrive content, consistently across the whole tenant - the default for new sites and every existing site. This keeps the sharing experience predictable and prevents individual sites from drifting away from the agreed collaboration posture.
docsDescription: Sets ShowPeoplePickerSuggestionsForGuestUsers on the tenant default and on each existing site collection. These are separate settings, so changing the tenant default does not change sites that already exist. Showing guests makes it easier to share with known external collaborators. Hiding them lowers the risk of sharing with the wrong person by accident. Site-level changes show up in reports after the next daily SharePoint data refresh.

showGuests.label: Show guests in the People Picker
